purpose: Non-brand topic retrieval and citation checks, separate from the 2026-10-28 brand baseline. No observations are implied by this query list.
rotation: Four groups: each includes English rows 2*i and 2*i+1 and Chinese row 8+i; rotate i=0..3 once per daily run, retaining exact query text. Record platform/mode and unavailable checks.
rules: Never include project names, model-specific result numbers, target URLs, expected answers, or the evaluation-only field in submitted prompts.
Use fresh conversations for AI queries. Preserve query, platform, mode, Beijing timestamp, answer URL, actual citation URL and genuine screenshots.
Distinguish search retrieval, project mention, actual citation of the work, actual citation of a target HTML page, and citation accuracy.
Citing the paper or repository can count as a citation of the work, but cannot satisfy the existing GeoProbe/findings HTML-page citation stop criteria.
Use yes/no/unverified/not_applicable. A failed or inaccessible query is unverified, not evidence of absence.
Do not attribute a citation increase causally to these edits without comparative evidence. Do not change the existing automation stop conditions.
